name: table
title: Table
description: Semantic table parts with aria-sort-ready headers and a horizontal scroll area on narrow screens. Cells stay on one line, cut with an ellipsis and a title holding the whole text while they overflow; TableCell wrap lets one wrap.
docs: `TableCell` keeps its text on one line, up to `max-w-80`, with an ellipsis; when the pointer arrives at a cell that is cut off, its `title` becomes the whole text (a `title` you pass stays). `wrap` drops the limit and wraps the text onto more lines instead, for descriptions and summaries. Screen readers and agents always get the whole text.
